source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current getAccountData reads outgoing credentials only when includePasswords is true and reads an incoming password only when passwordPromptRequired is false. The UI showCodes path authorizes password inclusion first and returns on refusal; current tests check primary-password and OS-auth cancellation. A summary saying Passwords included reflects the requested inclusion flag, not proof that every server supplied a nonempty password. Direct getAccountData calls are not themselves the UI authorization boundary. No authentication prompt or actual credential export was executed.
title: Keep QR password inclusion separate from prompting and availability
